name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
summary: +1 to any ability (max 30); teleport up to 30 feet right after you take the Attack or Magic action.

benefits.name: Blink Steps
benefits.summary: Right after taking the Attack or Magic action, teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.
benefits.text: Immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
